title: ffrwd.json
description: An ffrwd package manifest. name and version are required; a key outside this schema is rejected, not ignored.

name.description: <namespace>/<package>, each half a lowercase plain identifier. The namespace may not be ffmpeg or wasm.

version.description: The version this directory publishes as. Published versions are immutable.

description.description: One line about the package, shown in search results and on the package page.

lib.description: The exports. A string names one file whose export is named for the package segment; a map names several, one file per key.

bin.description: The recipes. A map key is a command word, its value one query file; a string names one file, its recipe named for the package segment.

dependencies.description: Package name to the version range as written. Recorded and shown, never solved; installs pin exact versions in ffrwd.lock.

keywords.description: Labels the registry indexes and ranks over. The compiler never reads them.

license.description: What the package is published under: an SPDX identifier or an expression over them. Shape only; no list is consulted.

homepage.description: A project page for the package, shown on the package page.

capabilities.description: What the host must grant this package's modules. Declared here and derived at publish from what each module says it does; a disagreement in either direction is a refusal.

ffrwd.description: The range of ffrwd versions the package declares it runs on. Checked for shape, recorded and shown, never a reason to refuse an install.

models.description: The model file each exported wasm function loads, keyed by the export's name. install fetches each from Hugging Face and verifies it against the pin; the model is never in the archive.

sha256.description: What the file's bytes must hash to.

private.description: true publishes each version private: installable with a token from the namespace, off the public index. A version's visibility never changes after publish.
